threat_event: A consultant's leftover access to a client's Workforce Cloud tenant is misused or taken over
threat_source: Insider; attacker using a consultant identity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,100 tenants keep partner access after project close
existing_controls: SSO with MFA for group consultants
treatment_plan: Expire access at project close; certify partner roles quarterly (POAM-015)

threat_event: Client data copied into the project collaboration workspace is exposed or kept for years
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention rule; broad project permissions
treatment_plan: Retention labels; delete client data at project close; no production data in the workspace without approval
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: A static migration key leaks from a consultant laptop or personal repository and is used against customer exports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 37 static keys with read on all tenant export prefixes; migration scripts kept in personal repositories against policy
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D2 migration toolkit; SYS-D1 export bucket
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 3); client contracts
treatment_plan: Replace keys with per-project, per-tenant short-lived credentials (POAM-001)
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Malware on an acquired-firm laptop spreads to client environments
treatment_plan: Group EDR on all acquired laptops (POAM-016)
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: A departed acquired-firm consultant keeps access through the separate identity provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Separate identity provider outside group HR events and certification
existing_controls: Manual deprovisioning by the acquired firm's IT team
treatment_plan: Feed HR terminations to the acquired identity provider now; migrate by 2027-03-31 (POAM-015)
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Federal contract information is stored where commercial project members can reach it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Federal projects share the commercial workspace
treatment_plan: Separate federal project area with restricted membership (POAM-025)
owner: Technology Consulting federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: Subcontractors handle FCI without the clause flowed down
owner: Technology Consulting federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: Ransomware in consulting spreads through the client access gateway into client systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway brokers sessions into about 160 managed-service clients
existing_controls: Brokered sessions with MFA; session recording
treatment_plan: Isolate gateway admin plane; per-client session policies; disable acquired-firm VPN path (POAM-017)

threat_event: Patient-level ADT test data from a hospital client is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: For 9 clients, patient-level ADT data passes through test environments
treatment_plan: Synthetic test data for all 9 clients; purge stored ADT messages

threat_event: A business associate breach notice to a hospital client is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hospital BAA terms are not in the group matrix
treatment_plan: Add BAA notice terms to the matrix (POAM-004)
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Client system credentials stored in project notes are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consultants keep client passwords in notes and chat
existing_controls: Policy requires the client's own vault
treatment_plan: Group vault for client credentials; secret scanning of the workspace
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Consultants paste client data into unapproved generative AI tools, or use the delivery assistant on federal work without approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Delivery assistant approved for commercial work only; the rule is not enforced technically
treatment_plan: Block unapproved AI domains on managed devices; client opt-in list for the assistant
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: A managed services outage breaches client service levels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Delivery centers depend on group identity and the gateway
treatment_plan: Keep; annual failover exercise between centers

threat_event: A fake client request tricks a consultant into changing a client's payroll or bank settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consultants act on email instructions from client staff
existing_controls: Change requests through the client ticket system
treatment_plan: Callback verification for any payroll or banking change

threat_event: Client audits of consulting fail because inheritance from group controls is undocumented
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: A consultant laptop is lost or stolen
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Technology Consulting security and compliance lead (Low)
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Covered telecommunications equipment is found in a federal deliverable and not reported in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Federal practice buys some hardware for agency projects
treatment_plan: Add the 1-business-day report step to the matrix
owner: Technology Consulting federal contracts compliance officer
